films.name: MADarwin
films.tagline: Versioned SKILL.md files compete in the same task environment, get scored on accuracy, evidence, compliance and clarity, and the winning variant is inherited — MA·Darwin runs the selection loop for Medical Affairs agent skills.

films.name: LogicViv
films.tagline: One reasoning card a day: each card names the hidden move inside an argument, then hands you three questions to ask before you believe it.

films.name: Music Viv
films.tagline: Describe the track in plain words and VivMusic rewrites it into a producer's brief, checks what the chosen Venice model actually supports, then renders the audio.

films.name: Gujarati Kids
films.tagline: Tap any letter to hear it, see its picture word and trace it — 283 illustrated words, 48 stories and 9 rhymes, with Guju, Nani and Vagh to talk to about any of it.

films.name: TrialPath (OncoMatch)
films.tagline: Describe how you feel in plain words and TrialPath returns open U.S. trial sites across 16 care areas — each with the reason it may fit and what the site still has to confirm.

films.name: WildDeed
films.tagline: Type any US address and WildDeed returns the wildlife record around it — GBIF occurrence records and IUCN status, live — then writes a 7-page naturalist's dossier as a PDF.

films.name: OpenEvidence
films.tagline: Comprehensive tracking of the fastest-growing medical AI platform in history — partnerships, products, funding, adoption metrics, competitors and tech stack, ranked by materiality rather than recency.

films.name: ProteinLens
films.tagline: Paste a sequence and get a structure, a per-residue confidence map, and a science-grade explanation — SimpleFold folds it with no multiple sequence alignment.

films.name: Designviv (Styles + Techniques)
films.tagline: 764 design styles, add-ons, interactive patterns and techniques — each with its palette, typefaces and a copy-ready prompt, plus one /catalog.json for agents.

films.name: Benchmark (ViviIndex)
films.tagline: 78 models, 545 scored runs, seven fixed-prompt tracks — one VivIndex score with cost per run and output speed beside it.

films.name: Mystery Menu
films.tagline: Two chefs, five secret ingredients each, twenty coins apiece — and one table voting on the dish they would actually eat.

films.name: Messy Action
films.tagline: 39 episodes of 100 Days of Messy Action — every 60–90s episode transcribed into 9,727 words and drawn into its own hand-written infographic field note.

films.name: Katha
films.tagline: 2,223 YouTube videos, ten channels, one identical briefing poster each — lessons, takeaways, mistakes, methods and stack, extracted and searchable.

films.name: NutriSnap
films.tagline: Drop a meal photo, read the numbers: every food item, its calories, and the total — no account, no database, just your own Venice key.

films.name: Venice Video
films.tagline: 47 Venice video models behind one prompt box — pick one, type the shot, and the interface already knows its length, resolution and audio.

films.name: KinderQuill
films.tagline: Say what the story is about and KinderQuill paints a whole picture book — every page illustrated and written for that story, never repeated.

films.name: Lemonviv
films.tagline: A face you can talk to. One still portrait, animated live by LemonSlice and written by Venice — English, Hindi, Arabic.
